ordered_diagnoses: Metastatic thyroid tumor from dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans

facts.raw_span: a 2-month history of right-sided neck swelling
worsening dysphagia
mild pain
a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck without fixation
the Pemberton sign was positive
TSH 0.363 mIU/L
Free T4 14.6 pmol/L
Anti-thyroglobulin antibody 1 U/mL
a hypo- to anechoic mass measuring approximately 6 × 4 × 6 cm
displacing the trachea 1 cm to the left
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of the right lobe yielded a hemorrhagic background with isolated clusters of pleomorphic round and oval nuclei
Contrast-enhanced CT of the neck and thorax confirmed a voluminous right thyroid mass and detected two pulmonary nodules consistent with metastases
